title: Frobenius-class rho in GT with a class-function slot and a repeat-slot squaring guard: m^2 traps 142 -> 0 per 1600, coalescence 1.000 at every checkpoint, W=2^125.819..125.820, conditional claim 125.8195 (offered only above a 125.8260 gate)

claims.statement: For the supplied nonidentity Q in BLS12-381 G2 and uniform z in GT, compute g=e(P0,Q), recover z=g^x by a Frobenius-class rho walk in GT and return [x]P0 verified against e(P,Q)=z.  The walk is a class function of the twelve-element Frobenius orbit: kappa is the index of the MINIMAL CYCLIC ROTATION of the twelve keys (Booth scan, 144 counted instructions; the minimal rotation of a vector is invariant under rotation, so kappa(y^(p^j)) = kappa(y) - j exactly and m0 = ks[kappa] is a class invariant), the slot is s = idx(H(m0)) with H the fixed 128-bit multiply-shift mixer, and the multiplier is M_s^(p^-kappa).  Exactly one class-history rule is added -- the repeat-slot guard: if the previous step was a MULTIPLY in slot h and the current slot is again h, the step taken is the cyclotomic squaring instead.  The p^6 cancellation requires M_s^(p^-kappa) * M_s^(p^-kappa-6) = 1, i.e. two CONSECUTIVE multiply steps in one slot, so the guard makes it unreachable; the guard reads only the current and previous class labels, so conjugate trajectories take identical decisions and remain conjugate.  Measured: 1600 conjugate start pairs x 100 steps stay in ONE class at every checkpoint 0..100 (exact twelve-Frobenius test), and the length-2 (class, A, D) census returns 0 in 1600 traces x 200 steps under the guard against 142 per 1600 under the rule it replaces.  A multiply step charges 22465 instructions (one dense Fp12 multiplication at C=20000 plus 2465 counted overhead including the 8-instruction guard row) and a cyclotomic squaring charges 15391; branch bits 0-2, index bits 3-14 and the 100-bit DP window are disjoint ranges of the 128-bit class label.  The algorithm METERS its charged work: forward steps, trail replays, the collision solve, the final verification and the output row are all debited and the next step's charge is tested against the cap BEFORE the step runs, so total work is at most the exact integer cap 75066045798762155095857850821322368670 work units (125.8195..125.8196) on EVERY run, with nominal work 2^125.819..125.820 (6005123112073628148903846038359316159550343/80000 units) strictly inside it.  The published number is derived, not chosen: it is the smallest four-decimal value c with 2^c >= W + 2e-5, and 2^(c-1/10000) is too small.  The success floor is at least 0.39 as COST_MODEL.md line 45 requires, and it is CERTIFIED rather than asserted: the birthday no-collision tail at S=75733449747618989859877151235676440719 steps with N'=N/rho and rho=(1-9/64)(1-1/4096) gives 0.430994, and S is sized so that this tail, divided by the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower end 905434717/1000000000 of the measured calibration ratio, still exceeds the target plus every debit, giving a certified floor of 0.390100.  The calibration is a one-command, one-configuration census of 48000 trials at the toy scale (16658 successes, rate 0.347042). The census walks 32 trails x 6 = 192 realized steps, not S_design=223; at the realized budget the toy model is 0.295768, so the measured rate is ABOVE its own budget's model (1.17x retention) and NO model-shortfall discount is due. The CP-95 lower end of the ratio is nevertheless applied as a conservative retention that sizes S, so the floor is a lower bound.  The density sweep detects 1593/1600, 1596/1600, 796/800 and 199/200 trials at 2^-5, 2^-7, 2^-9 and 2^-11 with zero degenerate matches.  The executed forced-match run on the guard table has per-event charge log, reported meter and recomputed row formula equal as exact integers (14880712 instructions, 691 log entries, full replays of 74 steps, x = 282239 verified).  The store is bounded by 60791734 52-byte records (3161170168 bytes) with a refuse-and-Chernoff policy, the R=4096 table is 28311552 bytes, and peak memory 3241910520 bytes is below 2^32.  H1'' (pair-collision rate at least rho/N), H2 (trace-bit pseudorandomness) and the random-mapping idealisation remain disclosed heuristics.  This number is offered only while the lowest live non-self submission on the track is at least 125.8260 (claim + 0.005 tie cap + 0.0015 margin); it is NOT asserted against a lower gate.  C=20000 instructions per dense Fp12 multiplication.
